svg.title: Spherity’s proposed runtime assurance architecture
svg.desc: Policy, domain and episode graphs feed admission and coordinated containment. An independent local stop works during model, graph, network and identity-service outages. Stops override admission at the resource boundary. Safe resumption requires verified recovery and separate authorization. © 2026 Dr. Carsten Stöcker, Spherity GmbH. CC BY 4.0.
